reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets a small business owner-operator with Bareni's calm, pragmatic tone, correctly prioritising process discipline over premature automation and adhering strictly to the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The core argument is clear from the opening sentence, logically structured, and plainly phrased without unnecessary jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides an immediate, low-overhead diagnostic step (manual spot-check on recent closed deals) and explicit rules on when to fix data versus when to automate.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated customer, capability, or performance claims; appropriately frames attribution requirements within realistic small-business workflows.
